title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: To determine if the columns are linearly independent, consider if any column can be expressed as a linear combination of the others.

title: Analyzing the Columns
text: Look at the relationships between the columns. For example, height (in) is directly derived from height (cm), and weight (lb) is derived from weight (kg).

title: Span of the Columns
text: The span of a set of vectors is the set of all possible linear combinations of those vectors. Consider if adding the new columns changes the span.
